regions.label: DemoInputScript
regions.evidence: Paired movement direction/coordinate records with FF terminator, consumed via $C0FE script pointer in attract routine. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: ReadySpriteTemplate
regions.evidence: Copy descriptor followed by repeating four-byte OAM records; $C1AA supplies descriptor to $C715. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: TitleTextAndDescriptors
regions.evidence: ASCII menu/license/title strings terminated FF, source/PPU destination descriptors; $FE74 converts characters to tile IDs and handles newlines. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: ScoreSpriteTemplate
regions.evidence: Copy descriptor plus repeated four-byte sprite records; adjacent score-display consumer. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: SaveSignature
regions.evidence: Four-byte DECO marker compared/copied by $C76E initialization. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: StageFloorHeights
regions.evidence: Six one-byte vertical bounds indexed by layout selector after $CEBE. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: StageIconDescriptor
regions.evidence: Bounded copy descriptor and tile payload passed to $C741 from $C928. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: ScorePPUDestinations
regions.evidence: Six little-endian PPU destination words, X<6 checked by $CA37 and doubled. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: LivesIconDescriptor
regions.evidence: Bounded copy descriptor/payload passed by $CA87. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: PepperIconDescriptor
regions.evidence: Bounded copy descriptor/payload passed by $CAA7. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: InitialExtraLifeParameters
regions.evidence: Four ordered non-code initialization parameters. $CB53 reads first value 02 into ExtraLifeThresholdStep and both next-extra-life BCD thresholds. Remaining three specific consumers unresolved. R01-004 independent consumer review; analysis/round02/review.md; historical evidence preserved in pass-001-final map.

regions.label: AttributeRowTemplate
regions.evidence: Copy descriptor and repeated attribute bytes; $CB88 copies then repeats six PPU writes. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: TitleTileRecords
regions.evidence: Eight pointer words read by $CBC1 loop count 8, followed by count-bounded copy descriptors/payloads and FF attribute runs. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: LayoutDispatchAndStagePointers
regions.evidence: First 32 bytes: 16 handler words indexed by command low nibble doubled at $CC9F. Remaining 12 bytes: six level stream pointers selected after $CEBE. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: GamePalettes
regions.evidence: Two 16-byte palette records selected by $CEC8 through $FDF0. All values valid NES palette indices. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: BonusTileDescriptors
regions.evidence: Pointer families and eight-byte bonus drawing descriptors/payloads: $CEFA and erase counterpart set stride eight; $CF54 adds stride. Separate player-mode indicator family uses seven. Exact existing non-code bounds preserved. R01-004 independent consumer review; analysis/round02/review.md; historical evidence preserved in pass-001-final map.

regions.label: CollisionCoordinateRecords
regions.evidence: Six little-endian record pointers and FF-terminated coordinate pairs consumed by $D0E4. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: PlayerIndicatorTiles
regions.evidence: Two pointer words plus four bounded PPU tile descriptors selected by player-mode renderer $D18F. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: ControlDirectionTables
regions.evidence: Five signed pepper X/Y offset pairs at $D268..$D271; twelve stored direction remaps at $D272..$D27D. Pepper facing indexes interleaved pairs; direction nibble indexes remaps. Opposing-input indices 12..15 cross next code; supported input domain unresolved. R01-004 independent consumer review; analysis/round02/review.md; historical evidence preserved in pass-001-final map.

regions.label: EntityAnimationTables
regions.evidence: Animation stream pointer pairs, repeated tile-frame sequences and signed movement deltas consumed by $D27E; explicit FF frame sentinels. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: MovementHandlerPointers
regions.evidence: Five little-endian motion handler addresses, bounded by first handler at $D47F; $D44F uses orientation nibble byte index. Does not claim full selector reachability. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: MovementAlignmentValues
regions.evidence: Two small constant data bytes between complete motion and alignment routines; inspect alignment consumers before inferring precise semantics. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: AnimationTileChoices
regions.evidence: Repeated five-byte groups of tile IDs, read by neighboring entity animation code. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: EnemyStageParameters
regions.evidence: Small repeated pacing/count arrays consumed by $DA99; independently bounded by next routine $DB45. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: EnemySpawnCoordinates
regions.evidence: Orientation and repeated X/Y coordinates read by $DB45 spawn logic. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: EnemyMovementRecords
regions.evidence: Six record pointers and repeated small movement selector streams with FF terminators consumed by adjacent enemy routines. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: BonusStageParameters
regions.evidence: Six tile selectors followed by six small duration/count parameters consumed by $E090 bonus logic. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: IngredientHandlerPointers
regions.evidence: 16 pointer words dispatched from ingredient state high nibble via $E11E; bounded by first handler NOP at $E170. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: IngredientTileRemap
regions.evidence: Two identical seven-byte small selector arrays between complete ingredient routines; adjacent graphic selection references reviewed. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: IngredientSegmentOffsets
regions.evidence: Four segment indices and four signed horizontal increments consumed by $E488 and callers. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: IngredientScoreParameters
regions.evidence: Two six-byte parameter arrays indexed by enemy count in $E5DE. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: PepperStunDurationValues
regions.evidence: Eight pepper stun countdown values selected by one-based total stage capped at eight using $E6A5,Y table-minus-one addressing, stored to EntityCountdown. Descending high-nibble steps; exact existing non-code bounds preserved. R01-004 independent consumer review; analysis/round02/review.md; historical evidence preserved in pass-001-final map.

regions.label: EnemyTileChoices
regions.evidence: Three four-byte tile arrays indexed by entity type at $E6AE. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: StageCompletionThresholds
regions.evidence: Five six-byte stage-dependent completion thresholds, read by $E771. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: DeathAnimationTables
regions.evidence: Ordered animation timer thresholds and repeated sprite tiles, read by $E81A. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: BonusSpawnTables
regions.evidence: Stage coordinate, sprite and selector arrays consumed by $E8A9. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: ScoreDigitTables
regions.evidence: Small decimal score/digit selection arrays consumed by adjacent score routines. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: EntityOAMOffsets
regions.evidence: Multiples of four for sprite slots and repeated tile constants read by collision/score logic. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: StageLayoutRecords
regions.evidence: FF-delimited three-byte layout/ingredient/ladder coordinate records, then bounded PPU descriptors, six-level pointer and parameter arrays. Consumers $CC9F/$CADC/$D68A agree with repeated records; exact sub-table semantics deferred. Boundary excludes trailing JMP at $F475. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: AudioBitMasks
regions.evidence: Eight descending powers-of-two used at $F6BA for sound-priority mask test. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: AudioCommandHandlers
regions.evidence: 27 handler words read by $F96E command decode. Exact physical interval ends at independently supported F96E routine; supported handler entry contracts separately reviewed. Natural command domain unresolved. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: AudioSequenceData
regions.evidence: 12 descending little-endian pitch periods, sound record pointers/descriptors and repeated duration/note/command streams. $F5B3 loads sound descriptors and $F6E4/$F748 interpret sequences; FF/command conventions and repeated channel initialization records visible. Detailed stream extents deferred. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: StartupPalette
regions.evidence: 16-byte NES palette, pointer supplied by $FD83 to $FDF0. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

Zero plus uniform FF non-code tail between terminal scroll-reset RTS and vector table; boundaries checked; specific fill purpose unresolved. Static physical inspection and consumer/pattern review in analysis/round01/structural-notes.md.

regions.label: CheckMusicReplacementPriority
regions.evidence: R01-003 independently reviewed: MusicRequest $05A2 identity from music load/stop writers; mask helper $F6BA preserves X and incoming header $91/$92, carry permission; both branches converge exactly on established $F611 effect loader and refusal RTS balances caller stack. Adjacent effect guard shares protocol. Exact boundaries previous RTS and independent $F604 slot entry; fixed NROM [0,1,0,1]. Supported precondition caller stack, X selected effect slot, incoming header and SoundRequest. Structural code only; natural entry unresolved, no observed fetch claimed. analysis/round02/review.md; analysis/redirect/round01-contract-review/findings.md
